headline: Turkey Proposes $6 Billion Industrial Decarbonization Platform at COP31
summary: Turkey plans to present an industrial decarbonization platform valued at over $6 billion at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, starting November 9.
why: Large-scale green investment initiatives are significant for infrastructure development and can attract international climate financing and foreign direct investment.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Government-backed decarbonization platforms provide funding and policy support for the green energy sector.
